tutorials.title: The Shifting Architecture
tutorials.summary: Inspect documents, keep your lantern lit, drink pain-killing elixirs when dread strikes, and follow the descending Roman numerals toward the Verdict.

tutorials.title: The Crimson Numerals
tutorials.summary: The central Antechamber wall counts down from IX toward zero as you clear the Kitchen, the Wood-Paneled Labyrinth, the Visceral Room, and the Memory Corridors.

tutorials.title: Void Crucible & Field Combinations
tutorials.summary: Drag materials onto gear in your Inventory (such as Ash Dust onto an Empty Vial, or a Crystal onto your Lantern), or use Void Focus & Crucible to forge blades and wards.
